data: What models are presented in the figure?

The figure presents three types of models:

1. 0th-order GMM (blue line)
2. 1st-order HMM (red line)
3. 2nd-order HMM (green line)

These models are compared across various numbers of hidden states (K) and model orders. The plots show the lower bound on marginal log likelihood and cross-validated log-likelihood on test data sets.
